recognize_zh: CD57 染色在大結節內與結節間都有大量散在的小型陽性細胞，結節內密度略高，右上方小濾泡周圍可見陽性細胞環狀分布；低倍率下無法評估是否圍繞大型 LP 細胞。
features: Abundant scattered small CD57-positive cells throughout the large nodule and interfollicular areas
Somewhat higher density of positive cells within the nodule compared with surrounding tissue
Ring-like arrangement of positive cells around a small follicle at the upper right
No clear clustering around large cells discernible at this magnification
Fibrous capsule at the right edge with sparse positive cells
describe_en: CD57 immunohistochemistry shows abundant scattered small positive cells distributed through the enlarged nodule and the interfollicular regions, with a somewhat higher density within the nodule and a ring-like distribution around a small adjacent follicle. Rosettes around large cells cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The pattern reflects increased CD57-positive T cells within and around follicles, which may be seen in progressive transformation of germinal centers; findings are consistent with PTGC when correlated with the H&E and IgD stains.

ddx.vs: NLPHL shows CD57/PD-1-positive T-cell rosettes encircling LP cells within effacing nodules, which must be excluded at high power.
Ordinary reactive follicles contain CD57-positive T cells mainly within the light zone of intact germinal centers rather than dispersed through an enlarged mantle-cell-rich nodule.
